deferrals.reason: Repo targets Python 3.12/3.13 (requires-python >=3.12, CI matrix 3.12/3.13, tools image installs 3.12). 3.14 is pending upstream verification: openhands-sdk support and build123d/OCP wheels for 3.14 are unconfirmed. Re-evaluate when the SDK's supported range covers 3.14.

deferrals.name: mcp
deferrals.reason: openhands-sdk 1.50.1 requires fastmcp>=3.2.0,<4, which requires mcp<2.0. Defer MCP 2.x until a supported SDK/fastmcp release removes that constraint.

deferrals.name: openhands-sdk
deferrals.reason: The mech-server image is assembled by the upstream agent-server build (sdk:openhands-agent-server/v1.50.1); its .venv packages (pypdf, urllib3, virtualenv, wheel, setuptools, msgpack, jaraco.context), nodejs_wheel node_modules, bundled Go binaries (rootlesskit, docker-buildx), and shipped Dockerfile copies (DS-0029) carry 70 upstream-borne Trivy findings currently covered by expiring .trivyignore waivers. Defer the bump until its changelog review confirms compatibility, then re-scan and drop cleared waivers.
